claim_text: Claimant reports a minor rear-end collision that occurred in a supermarket car park on 14 March 2024 at approximately 2:30 PM. The claimant's vehicle, a 2019 Ford Focus, sustained superficial bumper damage while stationary. The at-fault driver accepted liability at the scene and a police report was filed (reference: TR-2024-00412). No injuries were reported by either party. The claimant has provided photographs of the damage, a copy of the police report, and two independent repair estimates ranging from £620 to £680. This is the claimant's first submitted claim in the past five years. The at-fault driver's insurer has been notified. Repair work can be scheduled at the claimant's convenience.
